hero.description: My world moves between code and canvas. By day, I code; by heart, I create. Art is where I step away from logic and let color, texture, and emotion guide me. This collection is where those two sides meet — each piece a quiet balance of order and imagination.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A collection of moments, sketches, and visions from my artistic journey.

about.title: About the Artist
about.paragraph1: I hold bachelor’s degrees in Data Engineering and Mathematics and work full-time as a developer. My life has always revolved around logic and structure, so stepping into the world of art was something I never expected. I started painting and drawing about two and a half years ago, and it still feels like a wonderful surprise in my life.
about.paragraph2: Outside my tech career, art is where I step away from code and explore creativity in a more personal way. I’m entirely self-taught and love creating oil paintings, portraits, landscapes, and imaginative pieces inspired by curiosity and emotion. Painting has become my way of finding balance and expressing what words or numbers never could.
